nodes.author: SeherMirzaK
nodes.text: Responding to the concerns triggered by the detection of human metapneumovirus (#HMPV) cases in the country, the #JammuAndKashmir health department has set up a specialised ICU ward in #Jammu to address any potential outbreak of the disease. https://t.co/WGrYzvMvg5

nodes.author: SeherMirzaK
nodes.text:
"We have prepared a special ICU ward to handle any eventuality. God forbid if a pandemic occurs, we are ready," said Dr Hamid Zargar, medical superintendent of Gandhinagar government hospital.
#JammuAndKashmir https://t.co/jxiGkRbkRy

nodes.author: SeherMirzaK
nodes.text: "The centrally-heated ward has eight beds supported by ventilators and 24x7 oxygen supply," he added. Doctors have assured the public that there is no need to panic, emphasising that #HMPV is not a new pathogen and it is not causing a widespread outbreak. https://t.co/ZN9JNo4Wt8
